limitations: Historical registered case counts, not victim counts, current danger, rates or validated safety scores.
India Data Portal attributes its CSV to NCRB, but its district cells are secondary-source data; the original district workbook was not obtained.
The 2024 mirror combined subtotal differs from the NCRB Delhi UT total. Preserve the discrepancy and do not allocate it to districts.
Registration circles are the reporting units. Administrative district columns are retained verbatim and must not be used as a boundary crosswalk.
No verified police-district geometry, neighbourhood counts, time-of-day observations or exposure denominators are attached.
The mirror declares no licence. These attributed research extracts are not loaded into the public app; redistribution rights remain unconfirmed.
2024 includes both IPC and BNS reporting. Principal Offence Rule means these are recorded primary crime heads, not all allegations in every case.
